name: priority-queue
description: Binary heap-based Priority Queue supporting customizable sorting comparators.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when implementing search algorithms (like Dijkstra, A*), building rate-limiting queues, scheduler handlers, or resolving event ordering systems where values have weights/priorities.

parameters.name: comparator
parameters.description: A custom sort comparator function (a, b) => a - b. Negative means 'a' has higher priority.
